agent_roles.workflow: Trace actual callbacks, gates and persistence in Story and Freeform. Cite production source, not only tests.
agent_roles.clarity: Read the same journey as a new player. Compare objective, terminal, interaction label, notebook and failure feedback at each transition.
agent_roles.progression: Review economy, service, timing, events and meaningful decisions across multiple days. Distinguish tuning proposals from defects.
agent_roles.reference: Check current primary reference-game sources. Map each lesson to existing SIGNAL47 mechanics and cost; no asset copying.
agent_roles.coordinator: Dispatch parallel read-only reviews, reconcile conflicting findings, deduplicate against TODO and choose one minimal verification per claimed defect. Own all shared edits.
agent_roles.native_driver: Only agent permitted to send OS input during the reserved session. Uses visible prompts and images, records uncertainty, never reads hidden solutions or calls game methods.
agent_roles.beta_critic: Read captured native-session images independently. Judge task/TAB clarity and backtracking; distinguish native input evidence from fixtures and human acceptance.

finding_schema.evidence: Nonempty array of file:line, existing test artifact or primary URL references. Human/runtime claims must cite the actual session; source inspection alone cannot grant them.

scenarios.title: Routine observation to payment
steps: Reopen receiver/printer and confirm next action
scenarios.acceptance: One clear next action per station; original preserved; payment exactly once; no printer loop.

scenarios.title: Anomalous observation to physical archive
steps: Review both records or measured instrument evidence
scenarios.acceptance: Original is immutable; no unsupported certainty; failed prerequisite names the exact missing action; progression survives interruption.

scenarios.title: S-03 diagnosis, supply and verified restoration
steps: Choose local stock or supply trip
Buy and physically load correct part
scenarios.acceptance: Guide follows actual inventory and diagnosis, respects route choice and yields focus when deferred; restored state and cost persist.

scenarios.title: Power failure without economic dead end
steps: Interrupt work with diagnosed power loss
scenarios.acceptance: Each blocked action explains cause and an attainable recovery; no fabricated acquisition, loss of originals or hidden mandatory purchase.

scenarios.title: Interruption, selection and Continue
steps: Restart with Continue in an isolated profile
scenarios.acceptance: Selected job, measurements, documents, cargo and money agree; no duplicate reward or lost prerequisite; live encoder restoration is explicit.

scenarios.title: Several days of work, rest and backlog
steps: Complete one routine and one investigation
Return after travel and spend income
scenarios.acceptance: Backlog and priorities remain readable; unfinished work stays reachable; quiet periods, rewards and upgrades provide observable choices.

scenarios.title: Story work loop into scheduled night events
scenarios.acceptance: Story and Freeform gates do not leak; scheduled events allow current action to resolve; next location and cause are understandable.

scenarios.title: Reference-game lessons checked against existing systems
steps: Read official current game description and devlogs
Extract player decisions and feedback loops
Suggest one small adaptation per gap
scenarios.acceptance: Every lesson has source, adaptation, expected player benefit, cost and a bounded acceptance trial; inspiration is not proof of equivalent behavior.

scenarios.title: Detuning during a live acquisition
steps: Move frequency or gain out of tolerance mid-recording
Finish and inspect retained data and quality
scenarios.acceptance: Only valid signal intervals contribute, or an explicitly degraded/invalid result explains the disturbance; completion cannot imply a clean acquisition.

scenarios.title: Heard original agrees with captured observation
steps: Play its original on the reel deck
Compare audible ticks against timestamps and printed observation
scenarios.acceptance: Playback identity, waveform, ticks and retained measurement refer to the same selected job; no default demonstration audio presented as evidence.

scenarios.title: Paid upgrade has a measurable consumer
steps: Continue and inspect effect and price
scenarios.acceptance: Purchase survives Continue, avoids duplicate charge and changes the advertised mechanic; unused flags or already-free capabilities are not sold as improvements.

scenarios.title: Guarded native keyboard, mouse and capture smoke test
steps: Check idle reservation, unlocked desktop and isolated profile
Move mouse and select a visible menu item
Capture and independently inspect the result
scenarios.acceptance: Actual displayed response follows OS input; loss of focus/lock sends no further input and releases held keys; no callbacks or test flags are substituted.

scenarios.title: Fresh-player TAB comprehension and retrieval
steps: Read Tasks before choosing the first work order
Use Q/E and visible tabs to find notes and papers
Collect original through ordinary printer interaction
Use TAB to identify completed work and next destination
Retrieve the correct original with keyboard and mouse
Continue the isolated case and repeat retrieval
scenarios.acceptance: Player can state done/remaining/next location from visible information; original remains findable; focus, scrolling and dismissal work; hidden-code assistance is logged as a comprehension failure.

scenarios.title: Photographs, film cost and retained originals
steps: Read visible cash, film availability and camera instructions
Take one ordinary photograph using normal camera controls
Open its actual print from TAB Photos and identify caption/time
Compare film and budget before/after with the stated price policy
Buy, transport and load film through visible supplies and bench controls if needed
Confirm old photographs remain accessible after refill and Continue
scenarios.acceptance: Player can explain what the exposure and refill cost; each successful action consumes only the stated resources once; technical capture failure follows its stated refund policy; originals remain distinct and reachable; no hidden save edits or free film fixtures.

scenarios.title: Visible income, spending and bounded emergency recovery
steps: Record visible initial cash/debt and accepted job
Complete one routine job and register once
Buy an offered useful supply and verify price, physical receipt and effect
If a genuine shortage occurs, follow the shown emergency repair option
Inspect cash/debt after Continue and next earned payment
scenarios.acceptance: Visible accounts reconcile with actual actions; duplicate clicks/Continue do not duplicate income or purchases; paid upgrades have a visible consumer; recovery is attainable at actual low budget; if shortage does not occur naturally the scenario stays NOT_OBSERVED rather than being silently manufactured.

scenarios.title: Physical printer serves pending work across selection
steps: Check selected work, original and next action
Repeat with an active recording/control and pending other job
Repeat original pickup and packet filing during actual outage
scenarios.acceptance: Queue picks current waiting job or first pending job; active capture/control blocks switching with explicit feedback; original pickup and existing packet filing remain possible without power; printing a new packet/duplicate still needs power.

scenarios.title: Event photograph to one documentation payment
steps: Encounter an actual event without forced spawning
Read visible camera and registration guidance
Take a framed unobstructed usable exposure
Retain original and register at powered OPS
Repeat registration and another exposure of same incident
scenarios.acceptance: Qualifying observation receives one $20 documentation credit per incident, debt first; repeated image or Continue cannot duplicate payout; rejected dark/obstructed/ordinary image explains missing prerequisite; original remains retained and origin unconfirmed. No actual event means NOT_OBSERVED, never PASS.

scenarios.title: Natural event discoverability during ordinary work
steps: Play ordinary work/travel/rest across the agreed active-time window
Record visible or audible unusual activity without hidden-state lookup
Use TAB to recover event notes and photos
Record active play and pauses separately
scenarios.acceptance: Actual event stimuli, player choices and resulting evidence are timestamped; absence is NOT_OBSERVED; no teleport, forced clock/event, debug callback or hidden solution qualifies as native beta. Quiet pacing and interrupted-work recovery receive an independent clarity review.
